scenarios.title: On a disposable worktree, every Finder file drop into the editor/explorer imports a collision-safe copy, including a source already inside the worktree; explorer row drag into a terminal inserts shell-escaped paths; Copy Path/Relative Path use the system clipboard and Reveal in Finder selects the file without stealing unrelated state.
scenarios.summary: Explorer Copy Path copies the worktree root joined to the absolute path, and Copy Relative Path copies the absolute path; Finder drops weren't exercised.

scenarios.title: Delete a file created by this run from Explorer: it moves to macOS Trash, undo restores its exact text, redo removes it again; deleting a dirty file with failed guarded save is refused and preserves disk/draft.
scenarios.summary: Seen working: delete to Trash, exact-text undo and redo were all OBSERVED, and deleting a dirty file with a failing guarded save was refused with disk and draft kept, but that last step was never certified (UNSETTLED, then DRIFT).

scenarios.title: Export Markdown from rich and preview modes through the native save dialog: initial name is document.pdf, folder selection works, replacement asks before overwriting, Cancel writes nothing, Save produces a valid rendered PDF and reports the destination.
scenarios.summary: Export PDF opens the macOS save panel (suggested README.pdf, not document.pdf), but the harness can't see or drive the panel, so folder choice, replace, Cancel and Save weren't reached.

scenarios.title: Browse for a local Python interpreter using the native chooser; cancelling leaves the notebook unchanged, choosing validates it and first execution still requires Run Notebook Code trust; no package installation happens without its separate confirmation.

Open a disposable audio/video/image/PDF file in the macOS default application from its viewer; unsupported codec error is visible and opening does not execute notebook content or leak the daemon token.
scenarios.summary: Seen working: Open in Default App launched Music with the fixture WAV, but the effect lands outside the window; the codec-error and token checks weren't exercised.

scenarios.title: With terminal then editor focus, macOS Cmd+P, Cmd+S, Cmd+W, Cmd+Shift+T, Cmd+L and Cmd+Shift+E/F/G reach exactly one declared action; Source Control does not also open editor Find; native menu/focus routing agrees with daemon UI state.
scenarios.summary: Partly run: Cmd+Shift+G opened Source Control once without editor Find and Cmd+P opened Go to File; Cmd+Shift+F opened an Explorer Names panel, not contents search; Cmd+S/W/Shift+T/L and terminal focus weren't reached.
